title: S1 Division Practice: Polynomial Long Division Focus
subtitle: S1.a recall · S1.c Division · Word Problems · 8 Questions · ~45 min
purpose: Division-focused practice for Kai. S1.a recall targets his subtraction-framing gap (subtract A from B = B-A). S1.c is 5 division questions escalating from monomial to cubic with remainder. Closes with 2 word problems showing real-world division: area (find missing side) and rate (find unit rate).

questions.question_html: Recall Check. Subtract \( (4x^2 - 3x + 5) \) from \( (9x^2 + x - 2) \). Write your answer in standard form.
questions.hint: "Subtract A from B" always means B minus A. Write it as (9x^2 + x - 2) - (4x^2 - 3x + 5) FIRST, then distribute the negative before combining.

questions.question_html:
Warm-Up. Divide each term by the monomial.
\( (8x^3 + 12x^2 - 4x) \div (4x) \)
questions.hint: Divide each term separately: 8x^3 / 4x, then 12x^2 / 4x, then -4x / 4x. Subtract exponents when dividing powers with the same base.

questions.question_html:
Divide using long division. No remainder.
\( (x^2 + 9x + 20) \div (x + 4) \)
questions.hint: Step 1: x^2 / x = x. Multiply x(x+4) = x^2+4x. Subtract to get 5x+20. Step 2: 5x / x = 5. Multiply 5(x+4) = 5x+20. Remainder is 0.
questions.solution_html:
\( x^2 + 9x + 20 \div (x+4) \)
x^2 / x = x → x(x+4) = x^2+4x → subtract: 5x+20
5x / x = 5 → 5(x+4) = 5x+20 → remainder 0
\( \text{Answer: } x + 5 \)

questions.question_html:
Divide using long division. There is a remainder — include it in your answer as a fraction.
\( (3x^2 + 5x - 4) \div (x + 2) \)
questions.hint: 3x^2 / x = 3x. Multiply 3x(x+2)=3x^2+6x. Subtract to get -x-4. Then -x/x = -1. Multiply -1(x+2)=-x-2. Subtract: remainder is -2. Write remainder as -2/(x+2).

questions.question_html:
Divide using long division. No remainder.
\( (x^3 + 3x^2 - 4x - 12) \div (x + 3) \)
questions.hint: This is a cubic. x^3 / x = x^2. After the first subtraction you get -4x-12. There is no x term left — that means the x coefficient in the quotient is 0. Keep going: -4x / x = -4.
questions.solution_html:
\( x^3 / x = x^2 \) → \( x^2(x+3) = x^3+3x^2 \) → subtract: \( -4x - 12 \)
\( -4x / x = -4 \) → \( -4(x+3) = -4x - 12 \) → remainder 0
\( \text{Answer: } x^2 - 4 \)

questions.question_html:
Divide using long division. There is a remainder.
\( (2x^3 + x^2 - 5x + 1) \div (x - 1) \)
questions.hint: Start: 2x^3 / x = 2x^2. After each step, bring down the next term. Keep track of signs carefully — subtracting a negative is addition. Remainder will be -1.

questions.question_html:
Word Problem. A rectangular patio has an area of \( (x^2 + 8x + 15) \) square feet. The length of the patio is \( (x + 5) \) feet.

Write an expression for the width of the patio. Show your division work.
questions.hint: Area = length times width, so width = area divided by length. Divide (x^2 + 8x + 15) by (x + 5) using long division.
questions.solution_html:
\( \text{Width} = (x^2 + 8x + 15) \div (x + 5) \)
\( x^2 / x = x \) → \( x(x+5) = x^2+5x \) → subtract: \( 3x+15 \)
\( 3(x+5) = 3x+15 \) → remainder 0
\( \text{Width} = x + 3 \text{ feet} \)

questions.question_html:
Word Problem. A school printer prints a total of \( (3x^2 + 11x - 4) \) pages over \( (x + 4) \) minutes. It prints at a constant rate.

Write an expression for how many pages it prints per minute. Show your division work.
questions.hint: Rate = total divided by time. Divide (3x^2 + 11x - 4) by (x + 4) using long division. The answer should have no remainder.
questions.solution_html:
\( \text{Rate} = (3x^2 + 11x - 4) \div (x + 4) \)
\( 3x^2 / x = 3x \) → \( 3x(x+4) = 3x^2+12x \) → subtract: \( -x-4 \)
\( -1(x+4) = -x-4 \) → remainder 0
\( \text{Rate} = 3x - 1 \text{ pages per minute} \)
